This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

title: Senior Software Test Engineer
description:
**Job description for Lead/ Senior Test Engineer** 




**About PaperLite** 




  





 PaperLite is an enterprise\-software / SaaS startup based in Pune, founded in 2023, focused on workflow automation and enterprise collaboration solutions. We help organizations streamline notifications, task management, document tracking, secure file sharing, communication, data security \& encryption, access control, client management, and more.
 



 As a growing team, we’re building scalable infrastructure and systems to support our platform (for ourselves and our customers), and we are looking for a Lead/ Senior Test Engineer who can help make everything robust, automated, secure, and efficient.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We're looking for a
 **Senior Test Engineer** 
 who is equally comfortable doing hands\-on manual testing and building robust automation frameworks. You'll own quality across the product lifecycle: understanding requirements, shaping test strategy, writing and maintaining automated tests (primarily in Playwright), and integrating them into our CI/CD pipelines. You'll work closely with developers, product managers, business analyst and designers to make sure we ship reliable, high\-quality software.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Analyse business and technical requirements and participate in grooming and design discussions to identify testability gaps and risks early.
* Define test plans, test strategies, and test coverage for features, releases, and regression cycles.
* Perform hands\-on manual testing, including functional, exploratory, regression, integration, and UAT support.
* Identify test scope, risks, dependencies, and appropriate testing approaches for new features and releases.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI and API testing, with Playwright as the preferred tool.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps) and keep them fast, stable, and trustworthy.
* Write clear, reproducible defect reports, track them to closure, and help with root\-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (engineering, product, DevOps, design, analysts, support) to align on quality goals and release readiness.
* Monitor and report quality metrics such as test coverage, defect trends, and flaky\-test rates.
* Mentor junior QA team members and promote testing best practices across the team.
* Contribute to performance and load testing efforts where needed.
* Participate in and contribute to agile/scrum ceremonies.



  
 



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  




* 5\+ years of total experience in software testing / quality assurance.
* Strong hands\-on experience in both manual and automation testing. This is not a purely automation or purely manual role.
* Proficiency in automation using Playwright (preferred), or comparable tools such as Cypress, Selenium, or WebdriverIO, with willingness to work primarily in Playwright.
* Good Experience with mobile automation using Appium or comparable tools.
* Solid programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript (preferred), Python, or Java.
* Experience with API testing using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or Playwright's API testing capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Proven ability to create test plans, test strategies, and test cases from requirements.
* Experience with version control (Git) and test/defect management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Zephyr).
* Experience with load and performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to think like an end user.
* Excellent communication skills and experience working with cross\-functional teams.
* Deep understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and the SDLC.
* Experience with version control systems, preferably Git.
* Basic SQL knowledge for backend and data validation.
* Familiarity with visual regression, accessibility, or security testing.
* Ability to gel and work in a team and assist junior team members on techno\-functional grounds.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Good analytical skills with strong attention to detail.



  





**What We Value in You** 




  




* Strong problem\-solving \& troubleshooting instincts
* Great communication skills. Able to explain technical designs/questions to stakeholders, developers, security, etc.
* Ownership mindset. You care about platform reliability and user experience
* Willingness to learn and adopt new tooling / best practices



  
 



**What Will Make You Stand Out** 




  




* Experience in a SaaS\-based product company.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Familiarity with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes.
* ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer or similar certification.



   
 



**What We Offer** 




  




* Opportunity to be an early/hands\-on member of a startup building enterprise SaaS infrastructure
* Exposure to end\-to\-end systems: cloud, security, performance, scalability
* A collaborative engineering culture with learning \& growth
* Flexible / hybrid environment (if applicable)
* Competitive compensation \& benefits



  
 



**How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates, please send your updated CV to
 **recruitment@findingpi.com** 
 with subject line:
 **Application: Senior Test Engineer, PaperLite** 
 .

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**About Kaseya**
 Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.
   

  

 Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
   

  

 Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders \- and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
   

  

 We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better \- a product, a process, a career \- you'll fit right in.
   

  

 At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Kaseya is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – DevTest / QA Automation to design, build, and maintain robust automated testing capabilities across enterprise software platforms.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on software engineering role focused on test automation and engineering quality. The ideal candidate will have a strong programming background and be capable of building test libraries, automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and large scale automated test suites.
   

  

 The role requires an engineer who can leverage AI assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate automation, analyze existing codebases, generate and validate test scenarios, and rapidly expand automated coverage. The candidate should be comfortable working across application code, test infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, and production troubleshooting.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be able to take an existing codebase and, with limited direction, deliver hundreds of meaningful automated test cases within weeks, while maintaining quality, reliability, and maintainability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks, test libraries, utilities, and reusable automation components.
* Build comprehensive automated test suites for enterprise SaaS applications, APIs, services, integrations, and distributed systems.
* Write production\-quality code to automate functional, integration, regression, API, and system\-level testing.
* Analyze existing application codebases and rapidly identify opportunities for automated test coverage.
* Develop and execute large\-scale automation initiatives capable of delivering hundreds of automated test cases in a short timeframe.
* Leverage AI coding assistants and AI agents extensively to accelerate test development, test generation, code analysis, debugging, and automation engineering.
* Validate AI\-generated code and test cases through appropriate engineering practices, including code review, execution, debugging, and test\-result analysis.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and test execution infrastructure.
* Work with CI/CD runners, build systems, deployment pipelines, test environments, and automation reporting.
* Develop automation that can run reliably in continuous integration and deployment environments.
* Troubleshoot automation failures, application issues, environment problems, and production defects using logs, metrics, traces, code, and system behavior.
* Participate in production troubleshooting and issue reproduction, including supporting incidents or reproducing customer issues outside standard working hours when required.
* Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, DevOps, operations, and other QA/DevTest engineers to identify quality risks and improve engineering practices.
* Contribute to improvements in testability, observability, reliability, performance, and maintainability of the product.
* Identify gaps in existing test coverage and proactively create automation to prevent regression.
* Review application and test code and provide technical feedback on quality, maintainability, reliability, and automation effectiveness.
* Continuously improve automation speed, stability, coverage, and execution efficiency.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of software engineering, SDET, DevTest, or QA automation experience, with strong hands\-on programming experience.
* Programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, C\#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.
* Demonstrated experience building automation frameworks, test libraries, reusable testing components, and automation infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object\-oriented programming, data structures, APIs, databases, debugging, and version control.
* Experience developing automated tests for APIs, backend services, web applications, distributed systems, or enterprise software.
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution, including familiarity with CI/CD runners and build/deployment infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS or other cloud environments, with the ability to troubleshoot applications and test environments in the cloud.
* Experience troubleshooting complex application and production issues using logs, metrics, traces, database queries, and code level debugging.
* Ability to understand an existing codebase and independently build significant automated test coverage.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI assisted development tools/coding agents as part of day to day engineering and test automation work.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to identify root causes rather than simply report failures.
* Strong understanding of test automation principles, test design, regression testing, and automation reliability.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineering and cross functional teams.
* Willingness to support production issue reproduction and troubleshooting outside standard working hours when required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working on enterprise SaaS, IT management, cybersecurity, endpoint management, RMM, or other complex software platforms.
* Deep experience with AWS services and cloud\-hosted, data center hosted, or hybrid environments.
* Experience designing and maintaining large\-scale SDET/DevTest automation frameworks.
* Experience with API automation, integration testing, contract testing, service virtualization, or distributed\-system testing.
* Experience with tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, REST\-assured, pytest, JUnit, TestNG, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized test environments.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases, including writing queries for test validation and production troubleshooting.
* Experience using AI coding agents to perform tasks such as code generation, test generation, codebase analysis, debugging, refactoring, and test optimization.
* Understanding of application security, scalability, reliability, observability, and distributed\-system behavior.
* Experience building automation capable of operating at significant scale without excessive flakiness or maintenance overhead.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive automation initiatives from design through implementation and production adoption.


**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

title: Software Automation QA Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

**Automation QA Engineer — Cloud Security Posture Management**
**About the role** 
 Our CSPM platform discovers cloud resources across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI and evaluates them against security controls and compliance benchmarks. You'll own the automation that proves those controls are correct — a control that silently misses a misconfiguration is a customer security risk, not just a bug.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and maintain automated tests in Python (Robot Framework) and Playwright for cloud connectors, the evaluation engine, REST APIs, and UI.
* Validate control logic end\-to\-end — provision intentionally misconfigured cloud resources, verify controls evaluate correctly, and investigate false positives/negatives.
* Verify inventory accuracy across accounts, regions, and resource types.
* Test against real cloud API behavior — pagination, eventual consistency, throttling, and insufficient\-permission cases.
* Manage test environments involving Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Cassandra, and Kafka.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins / GitLab CI); debug failures and participate in code reviews.
* We use AI and LLM\-assisted tooling for test\-case generation and failure triage; you'll help shape where it's trustworthy and where it isn't.


**Required**
* 2\+ years in Software Automation Testing.
* Strong Python and hands\-on Robot Framework experience.

You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Test Engineer, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Experience in both Manual and Automation Testing.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
* Design and execute manual and automated test cases.
* Experience in both UI and API functionality and automation testing.
* Hands\-on experience in API and Microservices Testing.
* Hands\-on test automation skills with experience in BDD with Cucumber, Selenium with Java, WebDriver, Karate, Playwright, Cypress.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Ability to identify positive, negative, edge\-case, and comprehensive test coverage scenarios.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Proactive and self\-driven mindset.
* Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop, and execute testing strategies to validate functionality, performance, and user experience, while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to identify and resolve defects, and continuously improve testing processes and methodologies, to ensure software quality and reliability.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of comprehensive test plans and strategies to validate software functionality and ensure compliance with established quality standards.
* Creation and execution automated test scripts, leveraging testing frameworks and tools to facilitate early detection of defects and quality issues.         .
* Collaboration with cross\-functional teams to analyse requirements, participate in design discussions, and contribute to the development of acceptance criteria, ensuring a thorough understanding of the software being tested.
* Root cause analysis for identified defects, working closely with developers to provide detailed information and support defect resolution.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

 4\. API \& Database Testing (Learning Opportunity)

* Perform basic SQL queries to verify backend data.
* Understand frontend\-to\-backend integration and data consistency.


 5\. Quality Assurance Practices

* Maintain test execution reports.

* Contribute to improving test coverage.
* Learn automation testing and CI/CD quality practices over time.


 Required Skills \& QualificationsMust Have

 Good to Have

* Basic knowledge of Jira, Bitbucket, or other issue tracking tools.
* Exposure to automation testing tools such as Selenium or Playwright.
* Knowledge of browser developer tools.


 Skills We Value
 
 Attention to Detail
 



 Ability to identify inconsistencies and unexpected application behavior.
 



 Analytical Thinking
 



 Understand business scenarios and think beyond happy\-path testing.
 



 Communication
 



 Clearly communicate defects, observations, and testing progress.
 



 Learning Mindset
 



 Willingness to learn enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and automation.
 



  





 Internship Duration: 3–6 months (depending on the candidate's learning progress and organizational requirements).
 



 Potential opportunity for full\-time employment based on performance, skills, and business requirements.
 


 What You Will Learn
 
 During the internship, you will gain hands\-on exposure to:
 


* Testing a live enterprise business application.

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The SAP TM Transportation Management Senior Consultant serves as a senior\-level advisor responsible for leading complex SAP Transportation Management (TM) transformation initiatives for enterprise clients. This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end\-to\-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. The consultant participates in pursuing client sales opportunities and working on bid \& proposal efforts along with activities including configuration and setting up the SAP TM system, assessment of client business problems, conducting the analysis to solve the problems, administration of engagement activities while contributing to practice growth and innovation.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Responsible for the successful delivery of the SAP TM module related deliverables in SAP and S4 HANA implementation, support, and upgrade projects to meet engagement objectives and budget
* Lead design workshops with the client and responsible for requirement gathering, solution design, fit\-gap analysis, writing functional specification, system configuration, testing and cutover activities for both standalone SAP TM system and embedded SAP TM in S/4 HANA
* Design SAP TM system Integrations with other modules of SAP/S4 HANA (like EWM, SD, MM etc.) and 3rd Party system
* Provide functional and business process expertise to the project team, resolve TM related client s issues and mentor junior team members
* Handle various industry specific complex TM scenarios like shipper, LSP and carriers
* Work with sales team, write proposals, define SAP TM scope and effort estimation for the new opportunities and present SAP TM capability to the potential client


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Technical and Professional Requirements:**
* 5\-7 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM.
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)
* Ability to interact with other cross functional teams from modules like OTC, EWM for integration scenario
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co\-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business
* Knowledge in ABAP and debugging would be nice to have


**Core SAP TM Competencies**
* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer\-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation


**Technical Skills**
* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF\+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit\-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post\-implementation support


**Industry Knowledge**
* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real\-time visibility, autonomous transportation)


**Consulting Competencies**
* Proven ability to engage with client and support strategic decision\-making
* Expertise in requirements gathering through workshops, interviews, and process analysis; translating business needs into technical specifications
* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement
* Project governance frameworks, steering committee management, and escalation resolution
* Risk management, issue resolution, and proactive communication to ensure on\-time delivery


**T** 
**o qualify for the role, you must have**
* Degree in Engineering or MBA in Supply Chain Area.
* Desired to have SAP certification on SAP TM.
* Having experience of working in integration area of SAP TM and other areas.
* Minimum of 5\-7 years of experience in SAP TM.


**What We Look For**
**What we offer you**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development**

**People and Culture**

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits**

**How to Apply**

title: Professional Services Consultant
description:
Are you looking for an opportunity to help solve one of today's biggest business challenges? AI is changing the pace of business, and organizations everywhere are struggling to help their workforce, partners, and customers keep up. At Litmos, we're building the Learning Acceleration Platform that helps organizations build human capability faster—and we're looking for people who are passionate about making a meaningful impact for customers while growing alongside a collaborative, people\-first team.
   

  

 Litmos is the Learning Acceleration Platform that helps organizations build capability faster, adapt at the speed business changes, and scale learning to anyone, anywhere. Combining an intuitive platform, AI\-powered capabilities, trusted content, expert services, and a broad ecosystem of integrations, Litmos helps organizations accelerate workforce productivity, improve customer adoption and retention, enable high\-performing partners, and reduce organizational risk through continuous learning.
   

  

 Organizations such as Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Graco, Sabre, and Russell Mineral Equipment trust Litmos to accelerate learning across their workforce, partners, and customers. Today, more than 11K customers with 30 million learners across 150 countries and 37 languages use Litmos to build the capabilities their organizations need to succeed. Backed by Francisco Partners, one of the world's leading technology investment firms, we're investing in the future of learning—and the people who are building it. Learn more at www.litmos.com.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Professional Services Consultant is a hybrid role based out of our Pune offie location. The role works across four areas of PS work, depending on where demand is highest in a given week: helping prospects get value from their free trial, supporting implementation and onboarding, hands\-on technical consulting work across integrations and data migrations, and delivering managed admin services to our client base.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Trial \& Conversion Support**
* Monitor active trial accounts and proactively help prospects reach a meaningful setup milestone before the trial expires
* Provide lightweight, unsolicited setup help — configuration tips, content upload assistance, quick walkthroughs
* Flag high\-intent trial accounts to Sales for follow\-up


**Onboarding \& Implementation Support**
* Support Activate and Operate implementations the way a Customer Enablement Specialist would — user setup, content configuration, admin training
* Log CEM hours against fixed\-fee projects consistent with existing project tracking
* Help customers reach go\-live readiness on schedule


**Technical Consulting**
* Build, configure, and monitor integrations — SFTP, API\-based connectors, and Platform Connector (LPC) work
* Support data migration projects, including field mapping and validation
* Custom coding work: CSS and JavaScript for branding, portal customization, and configuration beyond standard options


**Managed Admin Execution**
* Identify accounts that need help with their administration, establish their managed\-admin needs, and help bring customers back on track with their Litmos set up, workflows and processes.
* Document value delivered to support the renewal/upsell conversation the CEM or AE ultimately owns
* Maintain all documentation in Salesforce


**What Good Looks Like**
* Trial accounts reach a meaningful setup milestone well before expiration, and conversion rate improves against baseline
* Implementation projects supported stay on schedule with clean go\-live readiness
* Technical consulting work (integrations, migrations, custom coding) meets the same quality bar as the existing one\-time consultant team
* A measurable share of at\-risk accounts convert to a paid Managed Admin package at or ahead of renewal


**Requirements**
**Technical**
* Working proficiency in CSS and JavaScript for portal customization and branding work
* Experience with API\-based integrations and data migration projects
* Comfortable scoping and configuring technical work with the same rigor as a senior consultant, not just executing a checklist


**Customer\-Facing \& Process**
* 3–5 years in customer\-facing SaaS support, implementation, onboarding, or renewals
* Comfortable working from data signals (usage, engagement, trial activity) rather than only inbound requests
* Familiarity with LMS administration; Litmos experience strongly preferred
* Salesforce Planhat proficiency for logging project hours, gift tracking, and trial engagement
* Understands scope boundaries across all four functions — this role executes and prepares, it does not own customer relationships or make commercial decisions


**Salary Range:** 
 ₹12,00,000 to ₹18,00,000 plus 10% bonus
   

  

 As a learning company we believe in the potential of everyone; if you don't have experience in all the details mentioned in this job post, then we still encourage you to apply and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity workplace employer. We are committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provide accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities.
   

  

 Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability.

title: Data Governance Technical Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
Successful candidate will be responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of data domains and data lineage by understanding and documenting application design in a concise, logical and understandable way in coordination with the Technology application teams. The role would focus on data governance implementation for a respective product and data domain, which includes registering critical data elements, authoritative data sources, data quality rules, and investigating any data quality issues The overall objective of this role is to contribute to continuous iterative exploration and investigation of attribute\-level data lineage, critical data element decomposition, application performance and other measures to gain insight and drive data governance planning and data remediation. This role will support the Payment, Core Accounts and Liquidity business, knowledge and experience in that domain is desired.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

  


 Formulate and define systems scope and objectives for data domain implementation and foster communication between data domain leaders and technology
   

  

 Register critical data elements, authoritative data sources, and data lineage in coordination with the data domain and technology application teams

 Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

 5 plus years of experience in data analysis with intermediate/advanced Microsoft Office Suite and SQL skills

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

 Qualys, Inc is a pioneer and leading provider of disruptive cloud\-based IT, security, and compliance solutions with over 10,000 active customers in more than 130 countries, including a majority of each of the Forbes Global 100 and Fortune 100\. Qualys helps organizations streamline and consolidate their security and compliance solutions in a single platform and build security into digital transformation initiatives for greater agility, better business outcomes, and substantial cost savings.
   

  

 As a Salesforce Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you should have around 7\-10 years of experience and good understanding of QA methodology, processes and associated automated testing tools. You would work as part of a dynamic team involved with testing web, portal, applications, and other new systems and/or enhancements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes
* Write and maintain clear, reusable test cases, test scripts, and supporting documentation.
* Analyze business and technical requirements, providing actionable feedback on specifications, design, and integration flows.
* Execute and evaluate manual and automated test results, ensuring defects are logged, tracked, and resolved in collaboration with development teams.
* Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, product owners, and project managers to deliver high\-quality Salesforce solutions.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and drive resolution of software defects across Salesforce and connected applications.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and process improvement.
* Actively engage in Agile ceremonies and support cross\-functional collaboration to drive efficient project delivery.
* Design, develop, and maintain robust automated test suites using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright for Salesforce applications and integrations.
* Stay current with evolving test automation tools, Salesforce release updates, and industry best practices.


**Desired Skills \& Experience**
* 7\+ years of QA experience with proven expertise in test automation using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright.
* Proficiency with automated testing frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or Cucumber.

 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. **We are looking for a Sub System Test Engineer – IXL \- Railway Infrastructure**
**You’ll make a difference by:**
* : Responsibility for the test execution/management of mass transit or main line rollouts of Interlocking (IxL) projects for CBTC/ Non\-CBTC signaling Systems as part of large\-scale railway infrastructure projects. Ensuring economic success and (internal) customer satisfaction for IxL domain in CBTC/ Non\-CBTC application projects Carrying responsibility for the lab data testing scope. Representation of the Test Team within a project when communicating to internal stakeholders, whilst reporting to the line management (test manager/group lead). Ensuring compliance with defined procedures/processes.

+ Preparation of test checklist specific to project and Create test specification / test cases as per IXL design requirement specifications.
+ Responsible for data lab testing of IxL Sub\-systems in Test lab using real and simulated test environments.
+ Review / verification of all documents related to Lab data testing.
+ Evaluation of project, customer, rolling stock and internal requirements towards executing suitable project specific test cases and test documentation.
+ Detailed knowhow on functional aspects of IxL and its interface with other subsystems like ATC and ATS with CBTC/non\-CBTC.
+ Knowledge about testing and commissioning process and Strategy.

title: Sr. Engineer Reliability Engineering XI
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Sr. Engineer – Reliability Engineering will be responsible for managing and executing
 **product reliability testing and validation activities within the Reliability Lab** 
 . The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The role will work closely with
 **Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross\-functional teams** 
 to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life\-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab.
* Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements.
* Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data\-acquisition systems.
* Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions.
* Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures.
* Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions.
* Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability.
* Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions.
* Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams.
* Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities.
* Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers.
* Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure.
* Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation.
* Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required.
* Analyze reliability data and identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support development and improvement of reliability test methodologies and laboratory capabilities.
* Mentor junior engineers/technicians on reliability testing, instrumentation, data analysis, and troubleshooting.


 Key Technical Skills
   

  

* Strong knowledge of Reliability Engineering and Reliability Testing.
* Hands\-on experience with reliability and environmental testing.
* Knowledge of FMEA, FTA, RCA, 8D, Weibull analysis, life testing, and accelerated life testing.
* Understanding of thermal, mechanical, electrical, and environmental stress testing.
* Experience with data acquisition systems, sensors, instrumentation, and test equipment.
* Ability to troubleshoot test setups and identify test\-system vs. product failures.
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
* Knowledge of relevant industry/testing standards and engineering practices.
* Good understanding of product design and manufacturing processes.
* Strong technical documentation and reporting skills.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related Engineering discipline.
* Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in Reliability Engineering, Product Validation, Testing, or Engineering Laboratory functions.
* Hands\-on experience working in a Reliability/Test/Validation Lab is preferred.
* Experience in HVAC, thermal management, cooling systems, data\-center equipment, power electronics, or similar engineered products will be an advantage.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Reliability \& Failure Analysis
* Laboratory \& Test Management
* Technical Problem Solving
* Data Analysis
* Root Cause Analysis
* Product Testing \& Validation
* Project Ownership
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Technical Documentation
* Decision Making


 Key KPIs
   

  

* On\-time completion of reliability and qualification testing
* Reliability test execution quality and accuracy
* Reduction in repeat/recurring test failures
* Timely identification and closure of reliability issues
* Effectiveness of RCA and corrective actions
* Laboratory equipment availability and utilization

title: Data Quality Officer
description:
**About The Role**
**As a
 **Data Quality Officer for HR \& Reference Data** 
 , you will be the key enabler in maximizing the value and trustworthiness of our most critical enterprise domains: our workforce information and core reference datasets.**
**You will act as a proactive partner, collaborating closely with business and technical teams. A critical part of your role is bridging perspectives—from HR business partners to IT architects—into clear, actionable data analysis.**
**Your mission is to resolve data issues and nurture a proactive prevention mindset across the organization. You will translate HR processes and Reference Data requirements into formal data quality policies, rules, and governance standards. By storylining data health metrics and serving as a data provocateur when needed, you will drive the continuous improvement of our core data foundation.**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Domain\-Specific Insight Generation \& Profiling:
+ Perform deep\-dive root cause analysis on HR datasets (e.g., employee lifecycle, payroll interfaces, org structures) and Reference Data (e.g., enterprise code tables, locations, job classifications, cost centers) to isolate systemic, process, or integration issues.
+ Conduct thorough data profiling on critical master and reference datasets to detect anomalies, cross\-system discrepancies, orphan records, and data drift.
+ Document findings and quantify the business impact of poor data quality on operational HR, compliance, reporting, and downstream integrations.

* Stakeholder Collaboration \& Standard Setting:
+ Work closely with HR Data Stewards, Data Governance, and IT to define, document, and enforce clear data quality rules and reference data standards.
+ Translate HR business rules and Reference Data governance policies into precise technical specifications for automated validation and monitoring tools.
+ Act as the primary liaison between business domain owners and technical teams, ensuring alignment on data lineage and data definitions.

* Monitoring, Reporting \& Governance:
+ Maintain domain\-specific Data Quality Dashboards (e.g., tracking HR data completeness, reference data synchronization) for clear visibility across business units.
+ Track and report HR and Reference Data quality KPIs to leadership, driving transparency and accountability.
+ Support reference data management processes, ensuring code values, mappings, and taxonomies remain synchronized across target applications.

* Remediation \& Prevention:
+ Collaborate with IT and HR Tech teams to define requirements for data cleansing, automated enrichment, and exception management.
+ Support business teams at the point of data entry/creation to improve source data quality and minimize manual workarounds.


****Your Profile****
* Boundary Spanner: Ability to connect HR business processes and enterprise reference data structures with backend technical architectures.
* Influencer \& Storyteller: Skilled at translating complex data anomalies into compelling narratives for HR leadership and business managers.
* Collaborator: A strong team player dedicated to building cross\-functional alignment across HR Operations, Enterprise Data Management/Governance, and IT.
* Mindset: Detail\-oriented, persistent, and proactive about driving data transparency and operational excellence.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, HR Analytics, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Data Quality Officer, Data Governance Analyst, or Data Steward, with direct experience handling HR data, Master Data Management (MDM), or Reference Data domains.
* Essential: Strong proficiency in SQL for complex data querying, profiling, and joining datasets across multi\-table environments.
* Hands\-on experience with modern HR Information Systems (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and Reference Data concepts (code lists, hierarchies, mapping tables).
* Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with global teams.


**Preferred Skills**
* Familiarity with Data Governance frameworks (Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Cataloging).
* Experience using scripting languages (e.g., Python) for automated data checks or profiling is a plus.
* Knowledge of global HR data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, local DPDP regulations).

description:
Senior QA Engineer
 



  





**Team:** 
 Healthcare EHR product engineering ·
 **Work model:** 
 WFO ( 5 days )·
 **Level:** 
 Senior individual contributor ·
 **Focus:** 
 test automation and AI\-augmented quality
 



  





 Role summary
 



  





 A senior QA engineer who builds automated test suites, embeds quality in an AI\-augmented (AI\-PDLC) delivery model, and drives the move from manual to automated testing for a healthcare EHR platform.
 



  





 Key responsibilities
 



  




* Build and maintain automated test suites (for example Playwright) integrated into CI/CD.
* Convert manual regression into reliable automated coverage on the critical paths.
* Embed in a squad: help write and refine acceptance criteria during the working session, and start testing as soon as the first build is ready.
* Use AI to generate tests, then validate that output rigorously — catching false positives and coverage gaps.
* Test AI\-backed product features: design evaluation checks for non\-deterministic behavior, including scenarios exercised from outside the code under test.
* Manage test data, including compliant synthetic data for a regulated (HIPAA) domain.



  





 Required skills and experience
 



  




* 5\+ years in software QA / test automation, with hands\-on framework build and maintenance (not only test execution).
* Proficiency with a modern automation framework (Playwright or equivalent, such as Selenium or Cypress) integrated into CI/CD.
* Programming for test automation in JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.
* Strong test strategy and risk\-based design, with fluency across API, UI, and integration testing.
* Hands\-on AI\-assisted or prompt\-driven test generation, plus the discipline to validate what the AI produces.
* Experience testing AI, machine\-learning, or LLM\-backed features — handling non\-determinism and designing evaluation/oracle checks such as golden sets and groundedness.
* A track record of converting manual regression into reliable automated coverage (shift\-left), working embedded in a cross\-functional team.



  





 Preferred qualifications (nice to have)
 



  




* ISTQB Foundation (CTFL) or AI Testing (CT\-AI) certification.
* Healthcare or other regulated\-domain testing, and synthetic test data (for example Synthea/FHIR).
* Performance testing, contract testing, or self\-healing test tooling.



  





 What a strong candidate looks like
 



  





 Has personally built automation up from a low baseline, can show AI\-assisted tests they wrote and then validated, and has tested at least one AI or machine\-learning feature with an evaluation harness rather than manual spot\-checks.
 



  





 Location and work model
 



  





 Hybrid, working within the product engineering team on its collaboration hours. This role is early in an automation\-first transition, so you will be building coverage from a modest baseline — a chance to set the standard rather than inherit it.
 



  





 Compensation
 



  





 Competitive compensation for a senior QA engineer, benchmarked to the local market. Specific range shared early in the process and in line with applicable pay\-transparency requirements.
 



 Equal opportunity and accommodation
 



 We are an equal\-opportunity employer and evaluate candidates on their ability to perform the essential functions of the role. We provide reasonable accommodation for applicants and employees with disabilities — please let us know if you need one during the process.

title: SAP CML Test Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: SAP CML Test Engineer**
**Corporate Title:** 
**Assistant Vice President**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Role Description**
* As an SAP CML Test Engineer, you will be a crucial member of our cross\-functional team, ensuring the quality, stability, and performance of our core Lending applications. You will leverage your expertise in both mortgages business processes and SAP CML to design, execute, and document comprehensive testing strategies. You will collaborate closely with Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers in both Pune and Frankfurt to verify and secure the technology solutions that support Deutsche Bank's lending operations.
* The Lending Platforms team is a global unit responsible for the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Deutsche Bank's core lending systems. As a critical function within our Private Bank Technology division, we manage the lifecycle of loan products on the SAP CML (Consumer and Mortgage Loans) platform. Our team is strategically located in Frankfurt and Pune, fostering a collaborative, multinational environment to deliver robust and innovative solutions for our business partners.


**What We’ll Offer You**
 As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
   

  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Test Strategy and Planning: Deliver a strong contribution with the test team, which will develop, document, and maintain functional and non\-functional test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on business requirements and technical specifications.
* Test Execution: Execute manual and automated tests for SAP CML and integrated systems, covering all phases of testing including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Regression Testing.
* Defect Management: Identify, log, and track defects with precision. Collaborate with development teams to analyze root causes and ensure timely resolution and re\-testing.
* Domain Expertise: Apply your in\-depth knowledge of the mortgages business lifecycle (origination, servicing, closure) to create/manage realistic and effective test scenarios.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work in close partnership with a multi\-national team of Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers across Pune and Frankfurt to ensure a shared understanding of requirements and quality standards.
* Reporting and Documentation: Contribute to providing clear, concise, and timely reporting on test progress, defect status, and overall quality to project stakeholders. Maintain comprehensive test documentation.
* Process Improvement: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing processes, methodologies, and tools.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* SAP CML Expertise: Proven, hands\-on experience in testing SAP Consumer and Mortgage Loans (CML) module. Strong understanding of CML configuration, processes, and integration points.
* Testing Proficiency: Minimum of 2\+ years in a dedicated software testing role with a strong grasp of QA methodologies, tools, and processes (STLC, SDLC).
* Mortgages Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of the end\-to\-end mortgage lending business process, from application and underwriting to servicing and securitization.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed, multi\-national team environment across different time zones.
* Analytical Mindset: Analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.


**Advantageous / Nice to Have**
* Test Management Tools: Familiarity with test management tools, particularly Tricentis Test, for planning and tracking test execution.
* Test Automation Tools: Hands\-on experience with test automation frameworks, especially Tricentis Tosca, for creating and maintaining automated test suites.
* Certifications: ISTQB/ISEB or other relevant software testing certifications.
* Agile Experience: Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.
* Broader SAP Knowledge: Experience with other SAP Banking Services modules (e.g., SAP BP, BCA) or FI/CO is a plus.
* German language skills: would be regarded as a plus point.


**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**
* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.


**About Us And Our Teams**
 Please visit our company website for further information:
   

  

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**
 We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
   

  

 Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
   

  

 We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Electrical & Electronics VAVE - Product Testing
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Description for** 
**Engineer – Product Testing(VAVE)**
**Job Description**
 Coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost\-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. The candidate must ensure that all VAVE changes maintain product performance, safety, and quality standards without compromising customer requirements. Being part of a Global Engineering Function, the role demands strict adherence to defined processes and communication protocols.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform testing and validation of VAVE\-related design and component changes in power supply products, modules, and systems.
* Conduct hardware and software testing (black box/white box) for communication power products to ensure compliance post\-cost optimization.
* Develop and maintain automated test programs for validating VAVE modifications efficiently.
* Formulate test plans, stress conditions, and procedures for evaluating new components or design changes introduced through VAVE.
* Collaborate with design, procurement, reliability, and compliance teams to verify cost\-optimized solutions without affecting performance.
* Ensure all VAVE changes comply with UL, CE, and other international safety and certification standards.
* Prepare detailed test reports, risk analysis, and recommendations for each VAVE implementation.
* Participate in root cause analysis for failures during VAVE validation and provide corrective action inputs.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cost competitiveness while maintaining high reliability and safety standards.


**Job Specifications**
* Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Power Electronics / Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
* Experience: 5 to 6 years of experience in power electronics product/module testing (AC/DC chargers, DC/DC converters, UPS preferred).
* Hands\-on experience in automation testing tools and programming for test systems.
* Strong understanding of analog and digital circuits, power conversion principles, and common topologies.
* Knowledge of safety certification processes (UL, CE) preferred.
* Familiarity with VAVE methodology, cost optimization principles, and supplier component qualification.
* Proactive, analytical, and result\-oriented, with the ability to think critically and solve problems independently.
* Excellent time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal in English).


**Key Skills**
* VAVE (Value Analysis \& Value Engineering) implementation and testing
* Power electronics testing (AC/DC, DC/DC, UPS)
* Automation testing and scripting
* Analog \& digital electronics troubleshooting
* Compliance \& certification validation (UL, CE)
* Test plan creation and execution
* Cost optimization validation techniques
* Strong problem\-solving and root cause analysis
* Hands\-on test and measurement capability (oscilloscopes, power analyzers, etc.)

**Company Description** 
 Sonaca Industries Pvt. Ltd. is a leading aluminium scrap recycling company based in Chakan, Pune, Maharashtra, specializing in premium\-quality aluminium ingots. The company operates a state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facility with advanced German technology and a robust monthly melting capacity of 1,200 MT. Sonaca focuses on low iron (Low Fe) aluminium alloys designed for Gravity Die Casting (GDC) applications, serving both automotive and non\-automotive sectors. Guided by innovation, sustainability, and strict quality standards, Sonaca promotes responsible recycling and circular manufacturing practices.

The individual will be responsible for overseeing the implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, applicable standards, and customer requirements. Key responsibilities include independently handling internal audits and coordinating customer, certification, surveillance, and external audits; managing CAPA, root cause analysis, and key quality metrics; and preparing and reviewing quality documentation and audit records. The role also involves supporting management reviews, facilitating cross\-functional communication on quality issues, coordinating quality\-related training, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The MR – Quality will work closely with operations, maintenance, and leadership teams to strengthen quality awareness, improve production processes, ensure QMS effectiveness, and support customer satisfaction. Internal Auditor certification and relevant experience in QMS and audit handling are preferred.

title: Application Development & Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 Position Overview
   

  

 The MDM Developer is a solid, independent contributor who builds and supports MDM platform features end\-to\-end. Owns features from development through production support under the “you build it, you support it” model. Works with moderate guidance from senior team members on complex design decisions but independently delivers sprint commitments and resolves production issues within their domain.
   

  

 Platform Development \& Enhancement
   

  

* Build and configure MDM platform features across assigned domains
* Implement match/merge/survivorship rules based on design specifications
* Build and maintain hierarchy structures and relationship configurations
* Build stewardship workflows and business rules per design specifications
* Implement region\-specific configurations including conditional attributes, validation rules, and approval routing per design specifications
* Build and maintain custom data entry screens and validation rules per design specifications
* Execute data mapping and onboarding for new sources per established patterns
* Execute data migrations and bulk operations per migration plans
* Implement platform enhancements and optimizations
* Participate in design discussions and raise technical concerns


 Platform Modernization
   

  

* Execute modernization tasks per established plans and timelines
* Implement data mapping per specifications during modernization phases
* Perform regression testing and report discrepancies during modernization


 Production Support, Troubleshooting \& Incident Resolution
   

  

* Own production support for features you built — resolve incidents within SLAs
* Resolve data issues within your domain; escalate cross\-system issues with root cause context
* Analyze application and database logs to identify issue root cause
* Identify patterns in recurring issues and propose permanent fixes
* Debug data flows within your domain to identify where failures occur
* Resolve defects in match/merge configuration and data processing logic
* Execute data reconciliation tasks and validate synchronization
* Collaborate with adjacent teams (data lake, ERP) when issues span system boundaries
* Share knowledge on resolved issues through documentation and team sessions


 Testing \& Quality
   

  

* Develop and execute test cases for SIT and UAT
* Perform system integration testing for assigned features
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback
* Refactor code to improve readability and performance

title: QA Engineer, Trading Systems
description:
QA Engineer, Trading Systems
 



  





**Location** 
 : Pune 
 



**Experience** 
 : 1 \- 3 years
 



**Engagement** 
 : Full\-time, in\-house
 



**Reports To** 
 : Head of Algo Trading / Founder
 



  





**About AJ Algo** 




  






 AJ Algo
 
 runs a portfolio of automated trading bots across Forex (MT4/MT5\), crypto exchanges, and equity/F\&O broker APIs. We build and operate systems that don't just generate trading signals, they execute them reliably, enforce risk discipline in code, and stay resilient around the clock. We're a small, hands\-on team where engineering rigor and calibrated scepticism matter as much as trading performance.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 You will own quality across our trading infrastructure, where bugs don't just break a feature, they can cost real money. Your job is to make sure every order, every risk check, and every model deployment has been genuinely tried to break before it touches a live account.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 Test the full order lifecycle: signal generation, risk checks, order routing, fill confirmation, and position tracking
 



 Validate risk management logic: position sizing, daily loss limits, drawdown stops, and margin safeguards, including edge cases like non\-USD\-quoted symbols and correlated exposure
 



 Test failure scenarios explicitly: rejected orders, partial fills, requotes, slippage, disconnects, and stale prices
 



 Verify reconciliation logic between bot\-held positions and broker/exchange records
 



 Test across multiple venues (MT4/MT5, crypto exchange APIs, equity/F\&O broker APIs) and catch behaviour that doesn't generalise across them
 



 Build and maintain automated test suites for money\-touching code, including unit tests for risk calculations
 



 Test monitoring and alerting: confirm the right severity triggers the right alert, and that silent failures don't slip through
 



 Validate ML model deployments: check that walk\-forward or purged cross\-validation was used correctly, and that shadow to small\-allocation to full\-allocation rollouts are gated properly
 



 Test server and terminal recovery scenarios: restarts, reconnections, and failover, confirming positions are reconciled before new trading resumes
 



 Log clear, reproducible bugs with steps, expected versus actual, and evidence
 



 Own the release checklist and sign off before anything ships to a live trading account
 



  





**Must\-Haves** 




 Manual testing fundamentals: test cases, regression suites, bug reporting
 



 Hands\-on automation experience (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Python\-based test frameworks like pytest)
 



 API testing and comfort reading JSON responses; experience with Postman or similar
 



 Basic SQL for verifying trade and position data
 



 Comfort with financial/numerical edge cases: rounding, lot sizing, tick values, and precision errors
 



 Ability to work directly with developers rather than throwing bugs over a wall
 



 A conservative, sceptical mindset: comfortable blocking a release when something is ambiguous rather than assuming it's fine
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 Experience testing trading systems, fintech, or other money\-touching applications
 



 Familiarity with MT4/MT5, crypto exchange APIs, or broker APIs
 



 Understanding of basic risk management concepts (position sizing, stop losses, margin, leverage)
 



 Experience testing ML model outputs where results aren't identical on every run
 



 Running tests in a CI pipeline on every merge
 



 Basic performance or load testing, especially around latency\-sensitive execution paths
 



  





**Share Your Resume** 




 Interested candidates can share their resume with us at: admin@ajems.com
